title.narrative: (i) To increase and modernize the provision of nephrology services in Cuba;

description.narrative: The acquisition of new artificial kidneys directed towards 44 nephrology centres. Replacing this equipment will improve the quality of the haemodialysis service for more than 1800 patients;The equipment of 3 new nephrological services located in three different provinces which will contribute to increase the service coverage and the management of new patients, including the development of ambulatory peritoneal dialysis in five provinces of the country.
